Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps to get the POC moving: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce average latency for chart-generation prompts under 300ms 95th percentile while keeping token cost < $0.0009/token for the front-end pipeline.
- Data constraints: PHI will not be sent to hosted API; POC will run on Dedicated/Test private instance in us-west.
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks of realistic traffic (pilot dataset ~1.2M tokens).

Proposed POC plan (high level) — attached detailed plan: 
1) Kickoff & infra prep (Redwood infra + customer network whitelisting) — owner: Marissa (Redwood), Rajesh (Acme) — target: 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-26
2) Integration & sample runs — 3 days
3) Evaluation window (2 weeks) with success criteria tracking — 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-12
4) Final readout + exec decision (45 min) — week of 2026-10-12

Success criteria (draft) — also attached as spreadsheet:
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for targeted prompt set
- Cost: average token cost < $0.0009/token for productionized config
- Accuracy: human eval quality score >= baseline on 3 prompt families
- Stability: no more than 2 infra-related errors per 10k requests

Immediate asks
- Jenna / Rajesh: confirm owners and that Acme data team can make the pilot dataset available by 2026-09-28.
- Marcus / Neha: I'll need a Dedicated test pool provisioned (small) and SOC2 attestation copy for legal.

Attaching: Acme_POC_plan_v1.pdf, Acme_success_criteria.xlsx

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142
